name: Online Child Sexual Exploitation (Financial Indicators)
description: Financial footprints of the purchase, sale or live-streaming of child sexual abuse material and related exploitation. Indicators are limited to payment patterns and account behaviour so that institutions can file reports promptly; staff must never access, view or retain the material and should escalate to specialist teams and law enforcement.

sources.text: Egmont Group and FIU public bulletins on online child sexual exploitation
FATF and APG, Financial Flows from Human Trafficking (2018)
WeProtect Global Alliance, Global Threat Assessment (2023 edition; earlier 2019, 2021)
UNODC and ECPAT public material on online child sexual exploitation

indicators.name: Repeated low-value payments to overseas recipients with live-stream links
indicators.canon: Repeated low-value payments to overseas recipients with live-stream links
indicators.desc: Small recurring transfers to individuals in jurisdictions of known high-risk, with references to live shows or streaming.
indicators.ctx: Small recurring transfers to individuals in jurisdictions of known high-risk, with references to live shows or streaming.
indicators.fp: Remittances to family and creator payments are common.

indicators.name: Payments to platforms flagged for illegal content
indicators.canon: Payments to platforms flagged for illegal content
indicators.desc: Payments to websites, hosting or payment accounts identified in intelligence as selling abuse material.
indicators.ctx: Payments to websites, hosting or payment accounts identified in intelligence as selling abuse material.
indicators.fp: Domain intelligence can include false matches.

indicators.name: Crypto transfers to addresses linked to abuse marketplaces
indicators.canon: Crypto transfers to addresses linked to abuse marketplaces
indicators.desc: Customer sends virtual assets to wallets clustered with abuse-related services.
indicators.ctx: Customer sends virtual assets to wallets clustered with abuse-related services.

indicators.name: Pattern of many small payments from many accounts to one recipient
indicators.canon: Many unrelated senders paying a single account or recipient
indicators.desc: Numerous unrelated payers send frequent, often small, payments to one account, wallet or beneficiary, or one funder pays many beneficiaries, with no clear commercial relationship.
indicators.ctx: Facilitator receives many micro-payments from unrelated senders.
indicators.fp: Content creators receive many small tips.

indicators.name: Customer receiving payments for access to minors
indicators.canon: Customer receiving payments for access to minors
indicators.desc: Account shows payments in return for introductions or access, plus use of prepaid cards and anonymous payment methods.
indicators.ctx: Account shows payments in return for introductions or access, plus use of prepaid cards and anonymous payment methods.
indicators.fp: Unrelated legitimate activity can resemble these flows.

indicators.name: Use of multiple payment apps and e-wallets with different names
indicators.canon: One person holding multiple identities or accounts
indicators.desc: The same individual appears under different names or opens several accounts or wallets, directly or through an intermediary.
indicators.ctx: Same user holds several e-wallets under various identities, funded with cash vouchers.

indicators.name: Requests for payments to be hidden or descriptions disguised
indicators.canon: Requests for payments to be hidden or descriptions disguised
indicators.desc: Customer uses deceptive references or asks to avoid records on payments.
indicators.ctx: Customer uses deceptive references or asks to avoid records on payments.

indicators.name: Payments from or to persons with prior convictions or adverse media relating to child exploitation
indicators.canon: Adverse media on customer or associates
indicators.desc: Credible negative news, enforcement notices or investigations link the customer, its owners or associates to criminal, corrupt or regulated-sector misconduct.
indicators.ctx: Customer appears in credible reports or sanctions of offences against children.
indicators.fp: Records may be old or mismatched.
